Headquartered in Ontario, Canada, D2L Australia Pty Ltd ("D2L Australia") is an Australian subsidiary of D2L Inc. The business provides a suite of proprietary eLearning software systems/solutions to clients and learners in higher education, schools, healthcare, government and the enterprise sector. D2L Australia is seeking a full time Software Engineer (Product Support Specialist) to provide advanced technical support for our eLearning software by investigating, diagnosing and resolving complex application issues experienced by customers. Acting as the primary technical escalation point for client technical teams, this role will be based in Melbourne (VIC 3000).

Base salary: $79,500 (plus super)

Main Responsibilities:
•	Analyse, diagnose and resolve complex application and technical issues reported by users through systematic investigation and troubleshooting. 
•	Serve as the primary technical escalation point for clients and internal teams, managing high-priority incidents and providing timely resolutions. 
•	Communicate with users via phone, email, chat and case management systems to identify, document and manage technical support requests within defined service levels. 
•	Research technical issues using product documentation, technical manuals and knowledge resources to determine root causes and implement effective solutions or workarounds. 
•	Identify and rectify configuration issues and perform advanced troubleshooting of authentication protocols, APIs, SIS integrations, LTIs and other application integrations. 
•	Develop and execute SQL queries and analyse IIS logs and diagnostic data to investigate application behaviour and accurately report technical findings. 
•	Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate complex issues, identify root causes and recommend appropriate technical solutions. 
•	Contribute to product improvement by preparing software defect reports, feature enhancement requests and identifying trends that support future technical modifications. 
•	Create and maintain technical documentation, including knowledge base articles, FAQs and support documentation for both internal teams and customers. 
•	Monitor and manage support cases by maintaining accurate case records, meeting service level objectives and participating in shift-based operational support.

Required Qualification and Experience:
•	At least a bachelor’s degree in computer science or other relevant fields in information technology or software engineering
•	3 years of work experience in a similar role
•	Customer service experience highly regarded

Ideal Skills and Attributes:
•	Ability to analyse, diagnose and resolve complex software issues through systematic investigation and root cause analysis.
•	Proficiency in web applications, APIs, SOAP/REST services, XML, HTML, Java, C#, .NET, JavaScript, LTI and related technologies.
•	Ability to write and interpret complex SQL queries, analyse IIS logs, and use diagnostic tools (e.g., Wireshark and Fiddler) to investigate application behaviour.
•	Experience with Active Directory, Office 365, OAuth, LDAP, SAML and related authentication solutions.
•	Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly, collaborate with internal teams and clients, manage escalations, and provide technical guidance and support.

Our client, Highflow Connections Pty Ltd, is a leading provider of NBN installation, repair, and maintenance services. Conveniently located in Hurstville, NSW, the company specializes in delivering reliable and efficient telecommunications solutions, including installation processes, network outages management, device compatibility, and ongoing repair and maintenance services.

With a commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction, Highflow Connections ensures that its clients receive top-tier support to stay connected. Utilizing advanced technologies and a highly skilled workforce, the company plays a vital role in shaping Australia's telecommunications infrastructure.

Highflow Connections is seeking a dedicated Telecommunications Cable Jointer, and, in this role, you will be responsible for joining, terminating, and repairing copper and fibre optic cables. Your work will ensure that telecommunications networks remain operational and meet the highest standards of quality and reliability.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background, hands-on experience in cable jointing, and a commitment to maintaining the integrity of telecommunications networks. You will work collaboratively with a team of skilled technicians to provide uninterrupted connectivity for clients.

Qualifications and Experience Requirements:

-	A Certificate IV in Telecommunications Technology or equivalent qualification.
-	At least one year experience in telecommunications cable jointing or a related field.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

-	Join, terminate, and repair copper and fibre optic telecommunications cables
-	Attach wires and cables to appliances and telecommunications devices.
-	Test and troubleshoot equipment using electronic instruments to identify faults.
-	Adjust, replace, and repair defective items to ensure network reliability.
-	Seal cable sheaths using lead and thermoplastic materials to protect against environmental factors.
-	Install and maintain aerial and underground wires and cables for telecommunication networks.
-	Erect and test support structures for overhead cable installations.
-	Perform regular inspections and maintenance of telecommunications systems to prevent outages.
-	Ensure all work complies with industry standards, safety protocols, and client specifications.
-	Assist in the installation of telecommunications equipment, including modems and routers.
-	Document work activities, including repairs and installations, for reporting and record-keeping.
-	Collaborate with team members to ensure timely completion of projects.

Skills Requirements:

-	Strong technical and diagnostic skills in telecommunications systems.
-	Familiarity with copper and fibre optic cables, including jointing and termination techniques.
-	Strong understanding of industry standards, safety practices, and regulatory requirements.
-	Physical fitness and the ability to work in confined spaces or at heights.
-	Proficiency in using cable jointing and termination tools and equipment.
-	Excellent problem-solving abilities to address network issues effectively.

We are seeking a Facility Manager to assist with the coordination and administration of commercial agreements and project-related documentation.

The Facility Manager is responsible for managing the delivery of commercial cleaning services across a portfolio of client sites, ensuring contractual obligations are met while maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

•	Plan, coordinate and oversee cleaning operations across multiple commercial, industrial and government client sites. 
•	Develop operational plans, staffing schedules and site allocations to ensure services are delivered efficiently and in accordance with client requirements. 
•	Lead, supervise and support site supervisors and cleaning personnel, including recruitment, induction, training, performance management and ongoing development. 
•	Build and maintain positive working relationships with clients by conducting regular meetings, responding to service requests and proactively resolving operational issues. 
•	Carry out routine site inspections to assess service quality, identify areas requiring improvement and implement corrective action where necessary. 
•	Ensure sufficient labour, equipment and cleaning consumables are available to meet operational requirements and coordinate procurement where required. 
•	Monitor financial performance of service contracts, including labour costs, material usage and operational expenditure, and recommend measures to improve efficiency and profitability. 
•	Coordinate the mobilisation of new cleaning contracts, including workforce planning, equipment deployment and implementation of site-specific procedures. 
•	Develop and implement operational procedures that promote consistent service delivery across all managed sites. 
•	Ensure all cleaning activities are conducted in accordance with workplace health and safety requirements, environmental standards and company policies. 
•	Investigate client concerns, workplace incidents and service failures, and implement preventative measures to minimise recurrence. 
•	Prepare operational reports, service performance reviews and management recommendations to support business planning and continuous improvement. 
•	Work closely with senior management to identify opportunities for business growth, contract expansion and improved service delivery. 

Requirements:

Applicants should demonstrate:

•	A bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Business, Management, Facilities Management or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience in a supervisory or management role within the commercial cleaning or facilities services sector. 
•	Proven experience managing multiple commercial cleaning contracts or facilities service operations. 
•	Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage supervisors and large operational teams across different locations. 
•	Experience developing staff rosters, allocating resources and managing workforce performance. 
•	Sound commercial awareness with experience monitoring budgets, labour costs and contract profitability. 
•	Excellent client relationship management and communication skills.

•	Practical knowledge of workplace health and safety requirements, risk management and quality assurance within a commercial cleaning environment. 
•	Experience coordinating subcontractors, suppliers and equipment maintenance. 
•	Strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to respond effectively to operational issues and client requests. 
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and operational management software. 
•	A current Australian driver's licence and willingness to travel regularly between client sites.
•	Language skills -  English

result.description:
Expected Salary: $75,000 – $90,000 per year

About Us
We have been making an impression since 1903 — making us Australia's oldest signage company. From our Sunshine West facility we design, fabricate, install and maintain signage for some of the country's best-known brands, covering everything from illuminated pylon signs and shopfronts through to large-format architectural and retail projects.

Our workshop is the heart of the business. We are looking for a skilled Fabricator / Welder to join our production team.

About the role
Reporting to the Production Manager, you will fabricate signage components and structures from mild steel, stainless steel and aluminum — working from shop drawings through to a finished product ready for paint, powder coat and installation.

Day to day you will:
Fabricate sign frames, lightboxes, pylon structures, brackets and mounting hardware
MIG and TIG weld aluminum, mild steel and stainless steel to a high finish standard
Read and interpret engineering drawings, shop drawings, specifications and cut lists
Measure, mark out, cut, fold, drill, grind and lines to tolerance
Assemble and trial-fit structures, including housings for illuminated and LED components
Prepare completed work for surface finishing and dispatch
Carry out quality checks against specification before sign-off
Maintain a clean, safe and organised work area and comply with all WHS requirements

About you
Essential
Trade qualification in Engineering – Fabrication (Boilermaker / Metal Fabricator), or equivalent demonstrated experience
Proven MIG and TIG welding ability, particularly on aluminum
Confident reading and working directly from technical drawings
Strong attention to detail and pride in finish quality — signage is a visual product and welds are often seen
Reliable, safety-focused, and comfortable working both autonomously and as part of a small team
Full working rights in Australia

Highly regarded
Previous experience in signage, sheet metal or architectural metal fabrication
Forklift license, EWP (yellow card) and/or Construction Induction (White) Card
Exposure to CNC routing, folding equipment or powder coat preparation

What's on offer
Full-time, ongoing position with a stable, long-established Australian business
$80,000 – $90,000 + superannuation, based on experience and trade qualification
Consistent hours with overtime available
Well-equipped workshop and on-site parking
Genuine variety — no two jobs are the same
A close-knit production team with long-tenured tradespeople

How to apply
Click Apply and submit your resume. Applications are treated in strict confidence. Only candidates with full Australian working rights will be considered.

3. RECOMMENDED SEEK SCREENING QUESTIONS
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a metal fabricator?
Do you have a trade certificate in metal fabrication or welding?
Which of the following welding processes are you experienced with? (MIG / TIG / Stick)
How would you rate your experience welding aluminum?
Do you have experience reading and working from engineering drawings?
What is your expected hourly rate?
Do you hold a current forklift license?

Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a Welder Fabricator?
Have you completed a qualification in engineering - fabrication?
Which of the following welding methods do you have experience in?
Do you have fabrication experience?
Which of the following forklift licences do you have?
Do you have experience operating a forklift?

result.description:
Run residential and commercial projects end-to-end with local stability, and a competitive salary package!   Your new company  
 Our client is a well-established and growing construction business delivering high-quality residential and commercial projects across regional Queensland. Known for their strong relationships, safe worksites and consistent project delivery, they provide a professional, team-focused environment with genuine investment in their people and ongoing business growth. 
  Your new role  
 As Site Supervisor, you will oversee the day-to-day delivery of construction projects, primarily focused on running site operations rather than being on the tools. You will coordinate trades, subcontractors and suppliers to ensure projects are delivered safely on programme and to quality standards. While the role is largely supervisory and project-focused, there may be occasional hands-on involvement as required. You will work closely with project management, providing clear communication, leadership and oversight across all stages of the build. 
  What you'll need to succeed  
 
 Proven experience as a Site Supervisor or Senior Foreman in residential and/or commercial construction 
 Strong understanding of construction methodologies, sequencing and site coordination 
 Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications 
 Sound working knowledge of WHS legislation and on-site risk management 
 Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills 
 Ability to manage multiple trades and competing priorities 
 Current Construction White Card 
 Valid Driver Licence 
 
 Desirable: 
 
 Trade background (Carpentry or similar) 
 Experience with subcontractor-driven projects 
 Exposure to digital site tools or project reporting systems 
 First Aid certification 
 
  What you'll get in return  
 You will receive a competitive salary package of up to $110,000 + Super, with some flexibility available for the right experience (within role scope). The package also includes a company vehicle or car allowance, fuel card, mobile phone and laptop, plus access to a supervisor bonus scheme following successful probation completion. You'll enjoy a standard 40-hour work week, stable local employment in Mackay, a supportive management team and the opportunity to progress as the business continues to grow and expand its project portfolio. 
  What you need to do now  
 If you're interested in this role, applications can be submitted via the "apply now" button. Please ensure you are submitting an up-to-date CV. If you have any further questions, please contact Mika Nuttall on (07) 4960 1128. 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.  Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
Location: Salisbury, QLD, 4107
Full-Time: Immediate start
Job Title: Welder
Salary range: $79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About the Role
Our client is a leading steel fabricator specializing in large-scale structural projects bridges, mining infrastructure, and commercial buildings. Precision, quality, and safety are at the core of their workshop operations. We are recruiting an experienced Welder to join their team and deliver high-integrity welds on heavy steel sections to exact engineering specifications.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
• Interpret detailed engineering drawings, blueprints, and welding specification sheets to determine material grades, joint configurations, and correct welding procedures.
• Select, inspect, and prepare metal stock; cut marked-out structural sections using oxy-fuel torches, plasma cutters, and guillotines to precise dimensions.
• Shape and bend steel beams, channels, and pipes using hydraulic presses, bending rolls, and manual heating/hammering techniques to achieve required profiles.
• Align and fit components using clamps, jigs, and measuring tools; join sections via MIG, TIG, flux-cored arc welding, and bolting/riveting methods.
• Examine completed welds for bead width, penetration depth, and dimensional accuracy; perform visual checks and assist with non-destructive testing.
• Finish products by grinding, filing, polishing, and cleaning weld zones; apply protective coatings or acid baths as per project standards.

Requirements
• Minimum two years’ welding experience in structural steel fabrication; relevant trade certificate (or equivalent) and current welding certifications.
• Strong ability to read and interpret technical drawings and welding symbols; thorough knowledge of weld procedures and site safety protocols.
• Capable of welding in all positions on heavy plate and sections; comfortable operating overhead cranes and workshop machinery.
• Relevant qualification to above field.

Apply now 
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience in Welder. Applications will be reviewed as received, therefore, please apply as soon as possible before the closing date.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.
